arm_set.name: replication_two_arm
arm_set.reason: only the two criteria that run 1 left unresolved are re-decided, and both compare PRODUCTION against coverage-only. Flying fixed and random again would re-litigate criteria that already passed on their own held-out worlds. 60 worlds x 2 arms is about 2.7 h at the 82 s per flight measured in run 1; 60 worlds x 4 arms would be about 5.5 h and would not inform any criterion.
arm_set.dropped_arms_reason: their criteria PASSED in run 1 and are not re-decided
decides_criteria: beats simple views on information/time/energy (coverage half)

decision_rule: Unit = one world, paired across arms. PRODUCTION beats coverage-only on a metric iff the lower bound of the 95 % paired percentile-bootstrap CI over worlds (4000 resamples) of the benefit (PRODUCTION better = positive) is > 0. Identical to run 1's rule, with the identical resample count and seed. 'beats coverage-only' = hidden_state_error_improvement; 'information/time/energy vs coverage' = info_per_time AND info_per_kj. ch25 leaves every numeric margin OPEN: no margin is invented and every paired CI is reported whatever its sign.
